tEn: Ten advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science
tZh: 数学与理论计算机科学的十项进展
sEn: OpenAI's internal model Astra solved ten long-standing math problems at under $2,000 each, showcasing AI's potential in research.
sZh: OpenAI 的内部模型 Astra 以每个问题不到 2000 美元的成本解决了十个长期未解的数学难题，展示了 AI 在科研中的潜力。
absEn: Ten advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science (via) A few days ago it was Anthropic discovering cryptographic weaknesses with Claude using Mythos Preview, spending $100,000 on tokens and with prompts that included "again we are not looking for low hanging fruit, we want proper research to find genuinely hard findings." Now it's OpenAI's turn to flex. They set "an internal version of Astra, our next major model" on finding solutions to ten mathematical problems that "have seen no progress on the main result for at least a decade". They claim to have spent less than $2,000 at GPT-5.6 Sol token prices on each one. (No news on how many problems they spent $2,000 on _without_ reaching a solution though.)
absZh: 数学与理论计算机科学的十项进展（转载）几天前，Anthropic 使用 Claude 的 Mythos Preview 版本发现了密码学弱点，花费了 10 万美元的 token，并提示“我们不是在寻找容易的成果，我们想要真正的研究来发现真正困难的发现”。现在轮到 OpenAI 展示实力了。他们让“Astra 的内部版本，我们的下一个主要模型”来解决十个数学问题，这些问题“主要结果至少十年没有进展”。他们声称每个问题在 GPT-5.6 Sol 代币价格上花费不到 2000 美元。（没有关于他们在多少个问题上花费了 2000 美元却没有得到解决方案的消息。）

contrib.en: OpenAI's internal model Astra solved ten long-standing mathematical problems with no progress for over a decade.
contrib.zh: OpenAI 的内部模型 Astra 解决了十个十多年未有进展的数学难题。

contrib.en: Each solution cost less than $2,000 in token prices, demonstrating high efficiency in AI-driven research.
contrib.zh: 每个解决方案的代币成本不到 2000 美元，展示了 AI 驱动研究的高效率。

contrib.en: The results are formalized in Lean 4, ensuring rigorous verification of the proofs.
contrib.zh: 结果在 Lean 4 中形式化，确保证明的严格验证。

contrib.en: OpenAI released a paper and an LLM-generated PDF reconstructing the proof process from reasoning traces.
contrib.zh: OpenAI 发布了一篇论文和一份由 LLM 生成的 PDF，从推理轨迹中重建证明过程。

contrib.en: The work highlights the potential of frontier models in advancing mathematics and theoretical computer science.
contrib.zh: 这项工作凸显了前沿模型在推进数学和理论计算机科学方面的潜力。

limits.en: The number of problems attempted without success is undisclosed, leaving the success rate unknown.
limits.zh: 未披露尝试但未成功的问题数量，成功率未知。

limits.en: The prompts used to guide the model are not released, limiting reproducibility.
limits.zh: 用于指导模型的提示词未公开，限制了可复现性。

limits.en: The results may not generalize to all mathematical domains, as the selected problems were specific.
limits.zh: 由于所选问题具有特定性，结果可能无法推广到所有数学领域。

limits.en: The cost estimate excludes potential hidden computational expenses, such as development and training.
limits.zh: 成本估算未包括潜在的隐藏计算开销，如开发和训练。

limits.en: The approach relies on the model's internal reasoning, which may be opaque and hard to audit.
limits.zh: 该方法依赖模型的内部推理，可能不透明且难以审计。

paras.en: Ten advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science (via) A few days ago it was Anthropic discovering cryptographic weaknesses with Claude using Mythos Preview, spending $100,000 on tokens and with prompts that included "again we are not looking for low hanging fruit, we want proper research to find genuinely hard findings."
paras.zh: 数学与理论计算机科学领域的十项进展（via）几天前，Anthropic 使用 Claude 和 Mythos Preview 发现了密码学弱点，花费了 10 万美元的 token，提示词中包括“我们不是在寻找唾手可得的果实，我们想要真正的研究，以发现真正困难的发现。”

paras.en: Now it's OpenAI's turn to flex. They set "an internal version of Astra, our next major model" on finding solutions to ten mathematical problems that "have seen no progress on the main result for at least a decade". They claim to have spent less than $2,000 at GPT-5.6 Sol token prices on each one.
paras.zh: 现在轮到 OpenAI 展示实力了。他们让“Astra 的内部版本，我们的下一个主要模型”去解决十个数学问题，这些问题“主要结果至少十年没有进展”。他们声称每个问题在 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 token 价格下花费不到 2000 美元。

paras.en: (No news on how many problems they spent $2,000 on _without_ reaching a solution though.)
paras.zh: （不过，关于他们花了 2000 美元却未解决问题的情况，没有消息。）

paras.en: The openai/ten-proofs repository has Lean 4 formalizations of their results, and there's also a paper describing the solutions and an additional LLM-generated PDF where the model "reconstructs how the proof came together" based on the unpublished reasoning traces.
paras.zh: openai/ten-proofs 仓库包含他们结果的 Lean 4 形式化，还有一篇描述解决方案的论文，以及一个额外的 LLM 生成的 PDF，其中模型基于未发表的推理轨迹“重构了证明是如何形成的”。

paras.en: That's a decent level of transparency, but I want to see the prompts they used!
paras.zh: 这种透明度还算不错，但我想看到他们使用的提示词！

paras.en: A lot of mathematicians online are experiencing a collective burst of Deep Blue. Mathematician Kirwin Hampshire published an impassioned essay last week, The Dark Night of Mathematics, describing "a profound spiritual crisis" brought on by previous (and less significant) results.
paras.zh: 网上许多数学家正经历一场集体性的“深蓝”爆发。数学家基尔温·汉普希尔上周发表了一篇充满激情的文章《数学的暗夜》，描述了此前（且不那么重要的）结果所引发的“深刻的精神危机”。
